The test image shows a soybean leaf with small, circular lesions scattered across the surface. The lesions have tan/gray centers with distinct reddish-purple/dark brown borders. The leaf is otherwise green and healthy.

Key features: leaf affected, circular spots, gray/tan centers, reddish-brown margins, scattered distribution.

Top candidates: Frogeye leaf spot (gray centers + reddish-brown borders), Bacterial Pustule (small light green spots with raised centers), Septoria brown spot (dark brown lesions).

Let me view reference images one at a time across candidates.
Strong match - frogeye lesions with circular spots, gray centers, reddish-brown borders on an otherwise green leaf. Very similar to the test image. Let me check one other candidate.
Bacterial Pustule lesions are smaller, darker reddish-brown dots without the clear gray center pattern. Less of a match. Let me check Septoria.
Septoria shows dark lesions on yellowing leaves - very different from the test image. Let me check a few more classes to be thorough.
Phyllosticta shows larger, irregular tan lesions - doesn't match the small circular spotted pattern. Let me check more classes.
Vein necrosis shows large yellow/orange irregular spots along veins - not matching. Let me check two more classes.
Cercospora shows dense reddish-purple specks on a yellowing leaf - very different. Let me check one more class.

Downy mildew shows small yellow-green spots only - no dark margins. Not a match.

**Summary of comparisons (8 references, 8 classes):**

| Class | Match |

| Frogeye_leaf_spot | Strong match - circular spots, gray center, reddish-brown border |
| Bacterial_Pustule | No - small dark reddish dots, no gray centers |
| Septoria_brown_spot | No - dark lesions on yellowing leaves |
| Phyllosticta_leaf_spot | No - larger irregular tan lesions |
| Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus | No - large irregular yellow spots along veins |
| Cercospora | No - dense purple specks on yellowing/bronzing leaf |
| Downy_mildew | No - small light yellow spots only |
| Septoria (already covered above) | N/A |
